title: Rework task system: collision-free IDs under concurrent pushers (kill shared .counter)
description:
DONE. Made the task system concurrent-safe and eliminated duplicate task ids.

ROOT CAUSE: the ./task CLI already serialized create with an fcntl.flock on .tasks/.mutex, so intra-worktree creates never collided. But each git worktree has its OWN .tasks/.counter + .mutex; two worktrees read the same committed counter and minted the same NNNN (1213/1217, 1201, 1211/1212), colliding only when merged to main. A shared lock is impossible across worktrees at create time, so a pure counter can never be collision-free.

FIX (ID design): ids are now NNNN-TOKEN-slug. NNNN stays a sortable, citable hint; TOKEN is a 6-char base36 timestamp+random token (always digit-leading) that is the uniqueness authority. Same-NNNN creates across worktrees get distinct ids/filenames and merge with no conflict -> collision-impossible without any shared lock. The digit-leading token lets migrate distinguish a real token from a slug word like 'golden'.

AMBIGUITY: show/update/delete/acquire/release/renew resolve exact id first, then a unique prefix; an ambiguous bare prefix (e.g. 1217 matching 2 tasks) fails loudly and lists matches.

MIGRATION: ./task migrate is idempotent/re-runnable -- already-tokenized ids untouched, legacy/colliding tokens derived deterministically from immutable task data. Migrated all 1266 task files (ids+filenames) with zero data/status loss (content set identical pre/post).

DUPLICATE REPAIR: 1213 (open QA finding, golden-parity SHAPE GEOMETRY) and 1217 (done, fix merged dbdd979) were the same work -> reconciled into one DONE record (1213) keeping the QA repro context + referencing dbdd979; deleted redundant 1217. Scanned all other shared-prefix groups: they are distinct legitimate tasks (now distinct via tokens), no other done/open same-work dup found.

TESTS: tools/task-concurrency.test.py (pnpm test:task) -- 5 tests: 32-way parallel create = 32 distinct ids; cross-worktree same-counter no collision; ambiguous prefix fails loudly (show/update/acquire); unique-prefix + exact-id resolve; migrate idempotent + collision-free. All pass.

VERIFY: swf 1373 pass; core 5237 pass (3 fails = missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, task 1207); authoring-ui 639 pass; typecheck clean. Docs: AGENTS.md (ID scheme/concurrency/lookup semantics/storage layout), CLAUDE.md Learnings.
